law_name: Loi n° 2024-449 du 21 mai 2024 visant à sécuriser et à réguler l'espace numérique (SREN)
description: Law securing and regulating the digital space. As Secretary of State for Digital Affairs, Marina Ferrari defended the final stages of the text before Parliament (after Jean-Noël Barrot). It introduces age verification for access to pornographic sites, an anti-scam 'cybersecurity filter' for the public, a mechanism for 'digital banishment' of convicted online harassers, measures against cloud lock-in practices, and transposes parts of the EU DSA/DMA framework.
significance: Flagship digital-sovereignty and online-protection law of the 2022-2024 legislature; the principal legislative achievement associated with Ferrari's tenure at the digital secretariat.
